{{Quote|It's a lab, all right. It's being used to bio-engineer creatures. This may be sanctioned for some labs, but this one is operating under the radar. This means trouble.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Joth]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CMAoD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Agents of Destruction|Corellia}}</ref>}}
An '''illegal lab''' was in operation on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|This...this is horrible! These creatures need to be destroyed, for their own sake as well as ours.|Lieutenant Joth, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CMRM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Researching Manipulation|Corellia}}</ref>}}
This [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] was located on an island off the southern shore of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Planet/Legends|World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], near the [[Suntir Plains]] and the [[Riverlands]].<ref name="SWG:CMAS" /> The laboratory was active following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and specialized in [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-engineering]] creatures. Genetic experiments being conducted in the lab were illegal and highly dangerous. For instance, the scientist were crossing DNA between aggressive creatures and passive members of the same genus in order to create powerful and intelligent fighting beasts.<ref name="SWG:CMRM" /> Engineered creatures included [[durni]]s, [[gaping spider]]s, [[bark mite]]s, [[kliknik]]s, [[tusk cat]]s, [[Boar-wolf/Legends|boar-wolves]] and [[Acklay/Legends|acklays]].<ref name="SWG:CMCOtZ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Clear Out the Zoo|Corellia}}</ref> [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Maldien]] was the [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] of the lab,<ref name="SWG:CMTHD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: The Head Doctor|Corellia}}</ref> and [[Jenson]] served as lead [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]].<ref name="SWG:MB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Missing Brother|Corellia}}</ref> Among the lab's residents included three [[Administrator/Legends|administrative heads]], [[Rond Fenimer]], [[Pirt Rawklin]], and [[Benn Calder]].<ref name="SWG:CMAoD" /> The [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Borgan]] once applied as [[Security officer/Legends|Security Director]] position at the lab but was turned down.<ref name="SWG:CIP1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Corporate Insecurities Part 1|Corellia}}</ref>

[[File:CorelliaBioLab-SWG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The interior of the laboratory.]]
The illegal activities in the lab were finally discovered after an informant known as [[Ja'inn]] reported some rumors about "dangerous things coming" to [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Joth]],<ref name="SWG:CMTDR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Tracking Down Rumors|Corellia}}</ref> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Lieutenant Joth tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with tracking down rumors. The spacer learn from Ja'inn that one of her friends, the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Moril]], got scared after shipping some rather odd items to a group that he couldn't name. When he was interrogated by the spacer, Moril confessed he was hired to deliver animal feed, chemicals and tranquilizer materials to the lab and what he saw there terrified him. Lieutenant Joth therefore ordered the spacer to go to the drop location for Moril's shipment and investigate the area.<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" /> Upon arriving to the lab, the spacers first attacked security officers to get the passwords needed to access administrative terminals.<ref name="SWG:CMAS" /> The spacer also killed the three administrative heads, Rond Fenimer, Pirt Rawklin and Benn Calder, to get their passwords. This allowed Lieutenant Joth to identify the building as a secret illegal lab. Joth consequently tasked the spacer to cripple the operations.<ref name="SWG:CMAoD" /> On the first level of the lab, the spacer also met [[Jeridel]], who was worried about her missing brother, the beast master Jenson.<ref name="SWG:MB" /> The spacer then entered the second level of the lab. There, the spacer fought some guards and researchers, disabled the security system control and downloaded research notes.<ref name="SWG:CMRM" /> The spacer also killed Doctor Maldien. However, Lieutenant Joth was worried about the beasts and ordered the spacer to neutralize them. The spacer therefore released a tranquilizer gas to subdue the animals.<ref name="SWG:CMTHD" /> In the lower level of the lab, the spacer fought the beasts that were still aggressive but managed to kil them all.<ref name="SWG:CMCOtZ" /> The spacer also collected some blood samples from the engineered creatures to [[Stregand]], the representative of a rival lab.<ref name="SWG:EB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Engineered Blood|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer eventually found the body of Jeridel's bother Jenson, killed by his own beasts.<ref name="SWG:MB" /> Finally, the spacer overloaded the lab's central computer, destroying all the research data collected.<ref name="SWG:CMStD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Shut them Down|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The illegal laboratory on Corellia was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:CMAS" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The illegal lab was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
